name: What factors determine the cost of repairing a bathroom door frame?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of repairing a bathroom door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends on whether the jamb requires a localized patch or a complete rough-opening reframing and finish rebuild. Patching minor damage or re-securing stripped hinge screws is straightforward and requires minimal materials. A full replacement involves removing the old frame, supplying a new jamb kit or pre-hung unit, adjusting rough framing, reinstalling or replacing casing, and tying into adjacent drywall and paint. If water has migrated into subfloor wood or adjacent tile, addressing those secondary issues will also influence overall labor and material expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the extent of water rot, whether adjacent drywall and tile are damaged, and if a simple patch or complete frame rebuild is needed.
